name: Nitasha Shal

text: I had the opportunity to collaborate with Felipe while developing Power BI dashboards for a business line of a Fortune 500 automotive client. As a subject matter expert on the data visualization team, Felipe consistently impressed me with his clear communication, deep expertise, and willingness to go the extra mile to support others. He is one of the most resourceful individuals I’ve worked with, and also one of the kindest, an absolute pleasure to work with.

name: Khoi Vu

text: I worked with Felipe on a couple of assignments during our time at Seneca College and I have thoroughly enjoyed them. He has proven to be a bright, dedicated, and pro-active classmate who always get his work done early to help others. As project's team leader, he was very well organized. I absolutely love working with Felipe and I have no doubt that he will be such an amazing asset to his future teams.
